title: Suvion Sustainability Report
description: All 12 required fields for an IMO-aligned vessel sustainability report

reportPeriodStart.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of reporting period

reportPeriodEnd.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of reporting period

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the report was generated

fuelType.description: Primary fuel type used during the period

co2EmittedKg.description: Total CO₂ emitted in kilograms (summed from emissions collection)

waterUsageL.description: Total fresh water usage in litres

generatorCurrentAvgA.description: Average generator current in amps over the period

avgTemperatureC.description: Average ambient temperature in Celsius over the period

carbonIntensityKgPerL.description: Carbon intensity: kg CO₂ per litre of fuel consumed

nonCompliantPeriods.description: Hourly windows where fuel or CO₂ thresholds were exceeded
